run_get_passing_only: run the get_passing_only script to filter TOD conversations by synthetic task success using --convo-path and --report-path
run_get_passing_only_with_filter: run the get_passing_only script with --filter-call-attempts to only keep conversations where API call count matches goal count
run_get_passing_only_cut_first: run the get_passing_only script with --cut-first-400 to skip the first 400 conversations and metrics entries
run_get_passing_only_to_file: run the get_passing_only script with --print-to-file to redirect stdout stats to a processed stats file
review_api_string_add: review the api_string_add method that normalizes API goal strings by keying on sorted API fields for found/not-found counting
